not_rendered.FireRed, Emerald (GBA): m4a/MP2K sequences + instrument banks: needs a sequencer and synth (agbplay has no Windows build; VGMusicStudio exports WAV one song at a time by hand).
not_rendered.SoulSilver, Platinum, Diamond, Pearl, Bl: SDAT SSEQ sequences + SBNK/SWAR banks: needs an SSEQ player (VGMusicStudio by hand, or NDS to NCSF + an NCSF player). No batch renderer runs here.
not_rendered.Super Mystery Dungeon (.cia): encrypted: would need decrypting on a 3DS first.
not_rendered.GBA/GB fan hacks (Sun-Moon FireRed, Swor: same engines as the GBA/DS games above (plus Game Boy sound for the .gb/.gbc).
